findings.title: The bounded firing still waits for the entire minute pass
findings.description: `fire_unit_until` calls `mt-run minute` synchronously before it polls the journal. The installed wrapper waits for the service to finish (`deploy/mt-run:127-129`), so the helper cannot see the trailing-complete marker or stop the unit until after the pass ends. Because the minute pass can continue backfilling for hours, this defeats the cutover’s bounded-firing behavior.

findings.title: The sudoers policy does not authorize the cutover commands
findings.description: The root rule does not include the defined `MT_INSTALL` alias, so the installer command issued by `cutover_common.install` is not authorized. The cutover also invokes the repair script through `sudo /opt/manta-trading/.venv/bin/python ...` (`scripts/cutover_921_minute_sessions.py:97`), which has no matching rule here. As a result, the supplied policy prevents the normal cutover from installing or running its repair and verification commands. Since `_repair` only logs a nonzero exit and returns its output, a failed verification may also be mistaken for acceptance if that output contains neither `FAIL` nor `[WAIT]`.

findings.title: The sudo rule grants root access to arbitrary mt CLI commands
findings.description: `/usr/local/bin/mt-run *` permits arbitrary arguments, not just the pass commands needed by the cutover. `mt-run` routes unrecognized arguments to the production `mt` CLI and, when run as root, loads `/etc/manta-trading.env` and executes that CLI as root. This gives the `manta` account privileged access to the full CLI surface, including maintenance operations, contrary to the stated limited-root intent.

findings.title: A timestamp alone can make an unpersisted bar satisfy a session
findings.description: `bar_timestamp` validates only a bar’s timestamp, and `sessions_without_bars` treats any timestamp within a session as coverage. But `_bar_to_row` in `minute.py` also validates OHLC prices and skips malformed bars. If a response contains an in-session bar with invalid prices and no usable session bars, the judge can mark the chunk `SUCCESS` and the gap can be deleted even though that bar is never inserted. The session check should count only bars that are valid for persistence, or verify stored coverage before advancing the gap.
